snippet.title: Backrooms: Rogue 0 — Official Teaser
snippet.description:
A routine expedition into the Backrooms goes silent. You are the last call.
Now trapped in endless corridors that loop into themselves, you’ll soon realize you are not alone. 
Something moves heremany things—and none of them can be fought. Your only hope is to stay unseen. Never trust what you see.
